Product Description:

Bogenia Loose Powder Banana is a lightweight powder that is ideal for setting makeup and giving a matte finish to the skin.

Key Features:
Provides a natural, velvety finish without weighing down the skin or creating a mask effect.
The powder effectively controls shine, eliminates oily sheen and helps hide minor imperfections.
Suitable for all skin types and can be used on the entire face and for spot correction.
The product is easy to distribute and apply in a thin layer.
